notes.title: Update 8.9.1 is Live!
notes.content:
We've made some improvements to bring you a smoother and more polished experience:

Changes:

Updated the input UI for a better typing flow
Improved visual effects while waiting for weapon generation
After defeating the King, the Black Cat will now leave a short meow-ment of feedback on your story
Fixed several bugs
That’s all for now, go see what the Cat has to say!

notes.title: Voice input + Women's Day Event!
notes.content:
Dear Storytellers,
    
Several months have passed since [b]"1001 Nights"[/b] first met you in its DEMO form. Based on your enthusiastic requests for new features, we're excited to bring our latest demo update:
    [list]        [*][b]Voice Input:[/b] Now you can literally "tell" stories to the King! Free your hands and defeat him with your voice![/*]        [*][b]New Weapons:[/b] We've expanded the armory with bows, arrows, hammers, and more! (We can't wait to see your crazy weapon combinations!)[/*]        [*][b]Story Export:[/b] You can now export your adventure stories as .txt files to share around![/*]        [*][b]Easter egg in Story Gallery:[/b] A special surprise awaits those who unlock all achievements and revisit the Story Gallery...[/*]    [/list]    
We're also thrilled to announce that [b]"1001 Nights"[/b] will be participating in the [b]Wings Women's Day Special Event![/b]
    
Thank you for your continued support. We'll keep updating the demo while working hard on the full version of the game ^ ^
    
Welcome to join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/bsCM47N9Qn]https://discord.gg/bsCM47N9Qn[/url]
    
Follow us on Tiktok & IG: @1001nights.ai
    
[b]We are also looking forward to more reviews from you ^ ^[/b]
    
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782660/1001_Nights_Demo/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782660/1001_Nights_Demo/[/url] (yes, reviews can be left in the demo as well!). Reviews are the best way to speed up our development!
    
Now, it's time for weaving the tales...

notes.title: 1001 Nights Recent Updates + Indie Live Expo
notes.content:
Dear Storytellers, thank you for playing 1001 Nights!

The demo has been live for a month now, and we've received thousands of stories and pieces of feedback - thank you so much for your amazing support! <3

As a small indie team, we could only make the game in our spare time. But we have always been grateful to have you with us! Your fantastic stories (we love how many Harry Potter tales have been told to the king, lol) and wonderful suggestions (like the adding weapon options!) have created such a strong sense of community and connection. We truly appreciate it and will continue improving the demo and adding more content.

Based on your feedback, we've been fixing bugs and improving content, and we want to share our progress with you:
[list]
[*] Fixed the palace dialogue freezing issue
[*] Fixed story organization in the story gallery
[*] Added king's dialogue interactions to the Story Gallery (every story deserves to be recorded, whether 'his majesty' approves or not!)
[*] Updated the BGM for the story gallery (More gallery content coming soon - stay tuned!)
[*] Made various other gameplay improvements
[/list]
Also, we will be exhibiting 1001 Nights at the[url=https://www.youtube.com/@indieliveexpo] Indie Live Expo [/url]on Dec 12th.
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/bsCM47N9Qn]Discord[/url]!
Follow us on X: [url=https://x.com/AdaEden1001]@AdaEden1001[/url] and TikTok [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@1001nights.ai]@1001nights.ai[/url]

We are also looking forward to you [b]leaving more reviews[/b] (yes, reviews can be left [b]in the demo[/b] as well!). Your reviews really help speed up our development! ↓↓↓

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782660/1001_Nights_Demo/

Check out the highlight video from our recent stream by Hanakyo!
We can't wait to hear more of your stories in this endless night...
